INCOMING NAVAL UPDATE - STAGING In the event you've been living under a rock the Naval Update is coming with the February wipe! Image We're encouraging anyone with the extra time and passion for its success to go play a bit of the staging branch (beta) between now and then.  Your feedback is valuable to us and you can submit that feedback using the F7 reporting system built into the game! To access Staging, simply download it from your Steam library! RUSTMAS BASE DECORATION WINNERS Over Christmas break we ran a Rustmas Base Decoration contest where players have a chance to win a bunch of cosmetic skin bundles. Image Happy to present our two winners! First place Kayli_j with a village that span across and entire mountain range. Image Image Image Image Full tour on her Youtube: YouTube Video Second Place MAK with his snow globe dome! Image Image There's a video tour in his X post that I'm unable to embed if you want to check it out! Congratulations to both!  Well done! RUST 12 - ART OF RUST The Art of Rust community have out done themselves once a again. They have a custom server where people from the community can decorate their own plots. They put together a tour for us and dedicated some of it to Rust's 12th Birthday.  They had concerts, fireworks, and much more. This is mostly going to be a photo dump and in no way could I ever capture how beautiful and heartwarming these scenes were using still photos, but being there was absolutely magical. I did manage to clip some of the opening concert (thanks Oriwell!) before the tour started though.  Its not very edited sorry not sorry. YouTube Video Here's a hefty photo dump.  If you're reading this on Steam go to the web blog for more! Image Image Image Image Image Image Image Image Image Image So much time and effort went into this tour and it shows.  Thank you Art of Rust!  Love you guys!
